raw_source_sha256
properties.bindingMeaning: source bytes only; (1)->(2) is an off-chain reproducibility claim (deterministic parse + canonical), not a proof fact

properties.name: program_hash
properties.definition: SHA-256(intent::canonical(Program)) from the current Core export [RO intent.rs:72-88,180 per T08 and dispositions F16; not re-read here]
properties.bindingMeaning: canonical Program identity; the layer a statement should bind

properties.name: circuit_program_digest
properties.definition: circuit-friendly digest of the same Program; needs an in-circuit SHA-256 of canonical JSON or a proven equivalence to program_hash
properties.bindingMeaning: unavailable: statements and bundles naming it are refused

properties.name: relation_id / template_digest
properties.definition: constraint-system / template identity of one circuit (relation_id lives in the AdmissionRecord; template_digest is a circuit constant, pinned by value in the row where the catalogue fixes it)
properties.bindingMeaning: for hand-lowered or per-program circuits, (2)->(4) is a compile/correspondence claim, vector-evidenced at most
